verdict.rationale: Gitea Actions workflows are YAML files in a GitHub Actions-compatible format, so they can be kept in a repository like other code. Gitea's commit history provides versioning, and Pull Request/AGit review with merge provides review. Rollback is only implied through standard git history rather than documented as a feature. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that workflows are stored and versioned in the repo, a documented rollback/revert path for automations, independent or hands-on corroboration of this workflow.
